The 2002 San Marino Grand Prix (round 4 of the season, held at Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari on 14 April 2002) was won by Michael Schumacher driving for Ferrari. Rubens Barrichello finished second for Ferrari, and Ralf Schumacher was third for Williams.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
